# Story-based interviews

## Directives

From [Digital product development](digital-product-development.md):

- Name the user and the task of each feature before you design or build the feature. ^name-user-and-task

## Definition

An interview that collects specific stories of past behavior, not opinions or predictions. Teresa Torres asks about a specific instance, such as "Tell me about the last time you watched Netflix." Most people move between the story and generalities, so the interviewer brings each answer back to the specific instance.
